BETA Close X Barratt Redrow plc has purchased 15,430,000 ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £50 million share repurchase program. The purchases occurred between April 27, 2026, and May 1, 2026, with prices ranging from 242.8000 pence to 261.2000 pence per share. Following these transactions, the company holds no shares in treasury, and its total issued shares stand at 1,411,196,582, with the same number of voting rights. Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 01 May 2026 01 May 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transactions in own shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 27 April 2026 to 1 May 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from UBS AG London Branch ("UBS") as part of its £50 million share repurchase programme announced on 5 January 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from UBS as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE"). Following the above purchases and cancellation of the ordinary shares, the Company holds no ordinary shares in treasury and has 1,411,196,582 ordinary shares in issue. The total number of voting rights in the Company is therefore 1,411,196,582.
